description: Use when an agent needs a U.S. company's SEC filings, key financials or the latest 8-K events. Input: ticker or cik, optional form, since, limit, items (8-K codes), mode (filings, events, financials). Output: company profile plus filings with sec.gov links; events = newest 8-Ks (no ticker: all EDGAR); financials = revenue, net income, cash flow, FCF, debt, cash, margins, debt/equity, YoY from XBRL. Example: ?ticker=AAPL&mode=financials Price: $0.0027 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key (e.g. 320193); give ticker or cik

form.description: Only these form types, comma-separated (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, DEF 14A, S-1, 4, 13F-HR…)

items.description: Keep only 8-Ks with these item codes, comma-separated (1.01, 2.02, 5.02, 7.01, 8.01…); other forms unaffected

mode.description: filings (default); events: 8-K events (without ticker/cik, the newest 8-Ks across EDGAR); financials: key figures and ratios from XBRL (ticker or cik required)

since.description: Only filings on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

ticker.description: U.S. ticker (AAPL, BRK.B); give ticker or cik

name: sec_filings
title: SEC EDGAR filings: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and more for any U.S.-listed company by ticker or CIK
